return_A.why_selected: Select c7 as the conditional Nautilus/IBKR destination, c4 as the separately qualified Alpaca SDK, and c5 as the local deterministic bridge into Nautilus. Source review of the [IBKR integration guide](https://nautilustrader.io/docs/latest/integrations/interactive_brokers/) establishes separate execution configuration and client-ID ownership requirements; catalogs/us-equities/runtime-target.json explicitly records IBKR acceptance as not established. Native execution retained in blueprints/us-equities/paper-e2e-20260921/paper-receipt.json shows the earlier alpaca-py runner completed one SPY roundtrip with two writes, independently matched -0.08 USD cash movement, flat final state and completed-trial recovery without additional writes. That result does not transfer to c5. For c5, blueprints/us-equities/adaptive-paper/receipt.json records local native-engine integration and 42 unchanged upstream adapter-template tests; its capacity fixture used a synthetic broker with zero broker connections and zero paper orders. These complementary selections preserve broker-specific boundaries and deterministic accounting without claiming native IBKR or adaptive-paper acceptance.

return_B.why_selected:
c5 is selected because it is the only adopted candidate whose retained evidence places a broker-specific boundary inside the selected NautilusTrader 2.0.0rc5 destination. c4 (alpaca-py 0.44.0) is selected as the official SDK that carries c5's transport. It is also the only adopted broker component with a retained broker-observed paper order result.

What the retained evidence shows, from my reading of the receipts (I did not re-run anything):

c5 (adaptive-paper-alpaca-adapter):
- blueprints/us-equities/adaptive-paper/receipt.json records status "local_integration_passed_new_broker_trial_pending" and pins NautilusTrader 1b0a49d2 and alpaca-py cc4cb3b7.
- The same receipt records 42 unchanged upstream Nautilus adapter-template tests passed, scoped "not Alpaca broker E2E".
- It records a full repository suite of 895 run, 893 passed and 2 skipped.
- It records a wall-clock native-engine capacity fixture with a synthetic broker: 180 submissions, 90 roundtrips, broker_connections 0 and paper_orders 0.
- The execution_contract block holds the deterministic numeric risk limits: 5000 USD gross exposure, 1000 USD order notional, 25 USD loss/drawdown, 200/180 per-minute request budgets and 1x maximum leverage. It also records a durable SQLite intent/fill/request journal and reconciliation-based recovery.
- blueprints/us-equities/adaptive-paper/README.md (Lifecycle and native boundaries) describes fsync-before-send reservations, stable IDs, an account lock, a flat-start requirement and snapshot reconciliation. It says ambiguous POSTs are never blindly retried.
- The later changes_since* blocks are all labelled evidence class SYN and are explicitly "not a new broker E2E".
- broker_readiness is "not_started" (regular_session_window_unavailable).

c4 (alpaca-py):
- blueprints/us-equities/paper-e2e-20260921/paper-receipt.json records a native Alpaca paper SPY long-to-flat trial through the SDK, with SDK source hashes for alpaca/trading/client.py.
- It observed 2 write attempts, both filled, and a realized gross PnL of -0.08 USD.
- A separate fresh read-only reconciliation passed with positions 0, open orders 0 and a cash delta of -0.08 matching the PnL.
- Completed-trial recovery made 0 additional writes.
- blueprints/us-equities/order-contract/README.md records a network-isolated native probe of alpaca-py 0.44.0 serialization. The SDK uses float fields and silently drops advanced_instructions and unknown fields, which is why the project wraps it in a strict offline boundary.

Evidence class: the winner set is local_integration, the weaker of the two. c5 has only local integration and synthetic evidence. The one native paper result belongs to a separate runner (blueprints/us-equities/alpaca-paper/paper_runner.py), not to c5.

return_B.overturn_when:
Any of the following would change this verdict:
- An open-session adaptive paper trial run through blueprints/us-equities/adaptive-paper/runner.py (paper, then recover) fails ownership, fresh cash/position reconciliation or numeric-risk enforcement.
- Induced partial-fill, cancel-race, stream-loss or ambiguous-submit faults in that runner (currently covered only by tests/test_adaptive_paper_safety.py and tests/test_adaptive_paper_recovery.py) are not handled.
- The Nautilus IBKR adapter (c7) passes the same ownership, reconciliation and partial/cancel/reconnect cases in a real paper session while c5 does not.
- A non-adopted challenger (HKUDS/Vibe-Trading's order gate, or a pydantic strict order-intent schema) is executed against the existing lifecycle cases in tests/test_alpaca_paper.py and tests/test_order_contract.py and produces fewer failures than the current deterministic adapter and hand-written boundary.
open_gaps: The adaptive Nautilus+Alpaca adapter (c5) has no broker-observed order. The receipt records broker_readiness not_started with orders_submitted 0. The only actual paper orders came from the separate one-SPY runner (blueprints/us-equities/alpaca-paper/paper_runner.py).

No native partial-fill, cancellation, rejection, disconnect, crash or in-flight ambiguous submission was induced against a broker. The paper receipt limitations say these paths have only synthetic test evidence, and recovery covered only a completed trial.
Cancel-then-replace, the gap-risk stop and overnight holds are opt-in SYN features with no broker-observed receipt (receipt.json changes_since_g_f_round8 limitations).
IBKR execution (c7) has no socket connection, paper session or reconciliation evidence.
Continuous operation, SIP-feed execution, Elite 1000/minute throughput and live trading are unqualified.
Historical-to-paper signal parity and the SPY/LEAN cash-parity oracle are still planned. No strategy profitability follows from any receipt read here.
alpaca-py serializes quantities and prices as floats and drops unknown/advanced fields (order-contract README). The exact-decimal envelope is not wire round-tripped.

Non-adopted HKUDS/Vibe-Trading and pydantic/pydantic have no retained evidence in this packet (empty evidence_refs). Their proposed comparisons are unexecuted, so neither can be preferred or rejected.

packet.title: Execution and broker adapters
packet.requirement: Use the selected NautilusTrader destination with broker-specific execution boundaries, deterministic numeric risk and reproducible equity accounting; preserve the prior LEAN oracle and qualify any strategy with causal data, costs and independent reconciliation.
limitations: Nautilus 2.0.0rc5 is a prerelease. The old September 19 Nautilus alternative and LEAN default cards remain historical; runtime-target.json governs the current destination.

The retained AAPL replay has 15 bars and five roundtrips per baseline/stress scenario with reconciled cash; it excludes known action dates and uses retrospective synthetic close fills with unlimited modeled depth.
SPY/LEAN dividend/cash parity is still planned. LEAN's known-crash fixtures are engineering stresses, not untouched holdout results or calibrated broker execution.

The Alpaca trial observed two actual writes, a -0.08 USD cash-matched gross result, flat/idle reconciliation and completed-trial recovery with zero additional writes. In-flight native failure cases, IBKR, live operation and continuous paper operation remain open.
No accepted point-in-time universe, extreme-mover/catalyst strategy, financing-inclusive performance or deployable profitability follows from these receipts.

Independent source review found two bare matches! expressions that do not assert denial-event variants in Nautilus risk tests, also present in v2.0.0rc5 source. Other tests assert denial and reasons. This narrow test defect is not an observed runtime failure; see docs/blind-catalog-source-adjudication-20260921.md.
The us-equities catalog also tags entries for this taxonomy layer under data-research (1); engines-strategies (5) was picked as the primary group by entry count.
packet.requirement_note: The requirement, limitations and existing_overturn_when text is shared by this layer's group; judge fit against the layer title and layer_scope_terms.
